items.title: Eastern Notes: Harden, Pacers, Okongwu, Daniels
items.summary: James Harden’s slow start to 2026/27 has led to some consternation in Cleveland, but the Cavaliers guard erupted for a season-high 51 points in Friday’s NBA Cup victory over Indiana, according to ESPN. Harden, who passed Kobe Bryant for the third-most 50-point games in NBA history with 26, is the fourth-oldest player to score 50-plus points in a game. The 37-year-old, who was plus-22 in 40 minutes, shot 15-of-26 from the field, including 7-of-11 from three-point range. He also made all 14 of his free throws in addition to having six rebounds and six assists. “That was vintage,” Cavs head coach Kenny Atkinson said. “You really can’t do anything if you’re the opposing coach. There’s nothing you can do, especially when he’s getting by you like that. You know, when they started taking away the step-back and he, you know, one or two crosses and he’s in the lane, then there’s just no stopping…

items.summary: Veteran center Jusuf Nurkic will be sidelined at least one more week due to the toe injury on his right foot, the Jazz announced in a press release. According to the team, Nurkic is making progress in his recovery and has been participating in on-court work. The 32-year-old big man will be reevaluated again in a week.
